snippet.title: Bearly Escape - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Don't miss the Version 1.0 Launch Trailer for Bearly Escape, a VR adventure puzzle game developed by Time Traveller. Players will embody kidnapped animals that have been taken by claw machines and turned to stuffed animal toys. Explore locations throughout the claw machine, solve puzzles, and aid in the escape to bring the animals home once and for all. Bearly Escape is leaving Early Access is available now for SteamVR and Meta Quest.
